# awscc_wellarchitected_agent_profile_policy (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfilePolicy



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `policy` (String) The IAM resource-based policy document as a JSON string. Allow-only statements, no negation condition operators, maximum 51200 characters.
- `profile_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parent Agent Profile the policy is attached to. Pass `!GetAtt` (or `!Ref`) of the parent AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfile to flow its ARN here. Also serves as the primary identifier of this policy attachment.
